title: Agent waivers (waivers.o3j.json)
description: Gate failures an agent accepted with a reason, written by run ops=[{op: "waive"}] (S3). A waiver covers one gate of one part definition. It is bound to the part's shape (shape_hash from the gate run, and the definition's geometry hash) and to the failure it was made for (value, limit and face, and the build direction for overhang), so a change to the part's shape or to the finding reopens the failure. Only agent-waivable gates appear here: watertight and bed need a person, through an approval (S5).

geometry_hash.description: The definition's geometry_hash when the waiver was made.

shape_hash.description: The part's shape_hash in the gate run the waiver was checked on. It changes when material moves, as when a hole moves inside a plate, where geometry_hash (a hash of the measures) does not.

at.description: Element address of the failure, for example face:7.

build.description: overhang only: the unit build direction the failure was found for.

reason.description: Why the failure is acceptable: visible text, without control or bidirectional-override characters, as the waive op writes it.

rev.description: The revision the waiver was checked on.
